evals.prompt: Dogfood the local app and focus on signup and settings.
evals.expected_output: Discovers or starts the app URL, ensures project .gitignore ignores .dogfood/, writes generated artifacts under .dogfood/, prunes stale irrelevant dogfood artifacts when safe, exercises signup/settings and adjacent user flows through the browser, captures evidence for each issue, reports coverage and blockers, and does not fix or inspect source unless asked.

evals.prompt: Dogfood the checkout page but do not place an order.
evals.expected_output: Tests checkout up to the explicit stop boundary, avoids final order submission, keeps evidence under .dogfood/, and reports post-submit behavior as intentionally untested.

Uses VFR/video/telemetry mode or reports dependency blockers, stores the run under .dogfood/runs/, records action markers, analyzes artifacts when dependencies exist, and cites contact sheets/anomaly evidence.
